### src/ami/session-engine.service.ts

```ts
import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import {
  AgentStatusCode,
  LegType,
  QueueEventType,
  SessionStatus,
  TransferResult,
  TransferType,
} from '@prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { RealtimeService } from '../realtime/realtime.service';
import { AgentStateService } from '../agents/agent-state.service';
import { CrmService } from '../crm/crm.service';
import { AmiEvent } from './ami-event.types';

function normalizePhone(phone?: string | null) {
  return phone ? phone.replace(/[^\d]/g, '') : null;
}

@Injectable()
export class SessionEngineService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(SessionEngineService.name);

  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly realtime: RealtimeService,
    private readonly agentStateService: AgentStateService,
    private readonly crmService: CrmService,
  ) {}

  async consume(tenantId: string, event: AmiEvent) {
    const eventName = event.Event!;
    const linkedid = event.Linkedid ?? event.Uniqueid;
    if (!linkedid) return;

    switch (eventName) {
      case 'Newchannel':
        await this.handleNewChannel(tenantId, linkedid, event);
        break;
      case 'QueueCallerJoin':
        await this.handleQueueJoin(tenantId, linkedid, event);
        break;
      case 'AgentCalled':
        await this.handleAgentCalled(tenantId, linkedid, event);
        break;
      case 'AgentConnect':
      case 'BridgeEnter':
        await this.handleTalking(tenantId, linkedid, event);
        break;
      case 'Hold':
        await this.handleHold(tenantId, linkedid);
        break;
      case 'Unhold':
        await this.handleUnhold(tenantId, linkedid);
        break;
      case 'AttendedTransfer':
      case 'BlindTransfer':
        await this.handleTransfer(tenantId, linkedid, event);
        break;
      case 'Hangup':
        await this.handleHangup(tenantId, linkedid, event);
        break;
      case 'AgentComplete':
        await this.handleAgentComplete(tenantId, linkedid, event);
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
  }

  private async ensureSession(tenantId: string, linkedid: string, event: AmiEvent) {
    let call = await this.prisma.callSession.findUnique({
      where: {
        tenantId_linkedid: { tenantId, linkedid },
      },
    });

    if (!call) {
      const ani = event.CallerIDNum ?? null;
      const normalized = normalizePhone(ani);
      let customerId: string | undefined;

      if (normalized) {
        const customers = await this.crmService.searchByPhone(tenantId, normalized);
        customerId = customers[0]?.customerId;
      }

      call = await this.prisma.callSession.create({
        data: {
          tenantId,
          linkedid,
          direction: 'inbound',
          ani,
          aniNormalized: normalized,
          dnis: event.Exten ?? null,
          didNumber: event.Exten ?? null,
          sessionStatus: SessionStatus.NEW,
          startedAt: new Date(),
          customerId,
        },
      });

      this.realtime.emitTenant(tenantId, 'call.created', {
        callId: call.callId,
        linkedid: call.linkedid,
        ani: call.ani,
        queueName: call.queueName,
        sessionStatus: call.sessionStatus,
      });

      if (customerId) {
        const customer = await this.prisma.customer.findUnique({
          where: { customerId },
        });
        if (customer) {
          this.realtime.emitTenant(tenantId, 'screenpop.customer', {
            linkedid,
            customerId,
            customerName: customer.customerName,
            grade: customer.grade,
          });
        }
      }
    }

    return call;
  }

  private async upsertLeg(tenantId: string, callId: string, linkedid: string, event: AmiEvent) {
    if (!event.Uniqueid) return;

    const channel = event.Channel ?? null;
    const endpoint =
      channel?.startsWith('PJSIP/')
        ? channel.split('-')[0]
        : null;

    const agent = endpoint
      ? await this.prisma.agent.findFirst({
          where: {
            tenantId,
            OR: [{ sipEndpoint: endpoint }, { extension: endpoint.replace('PJSIP/', '') }],
          },
        })
      : null;

    await this.prisma.callLeg.upsert({
      where: {
        tenantId_uniqueid: {
          tenantId,
          uniqueid: event.Uniqueid,
        },
      },
      update: {
        channelName: channel,
        endpoint,
        agentId: agent?.agentId,
        stateCode: event.ChannelStateDesc ?? null,
      },
      create: {
        callId,
        tenantId,
        linkedid,
        uniqueid: event.Uniqueid,
        legType: channel?.includes('Local/')
          ? LegType.local
          : channel?.includes('PJSIP/')
          ? LegType.agent
          : LegType.inbound,
        channelName: channel,
        endpoint,
        agentId: agent?.agentId,
        stateCode: event.ChannelStateDesc ?? null,
        startedAt: new Date(),
      },
    });
  }

  private async handleNewChannel(tenantId: string, linkedid: string, event: AmiEvent) {
    const call = await this.ensureSession(tenantId, linkedid, event);
    await this.upsertLeg(tenantId, call.callId, linkedid, event);
  }

  private async handleQueueJoin(tenantId: string, linkedid: string, event: AmiEvent) {
    const call = await this.ensureSession(tenantId, linkedid, event);
    const queueName = event.Queue ?? 'sales';

    await this.prisma.callSession.update({
      where: { callId: call.callId },
      data: {
        queueName,
        sessionStatus: SessionStatus.QUEUED,
        queuedAt: new Date(),
      },
    });

    await this.prisma.queueEvent.create({
      data: {
        callId: call.callId,
        tenantId,
        linkedid,
        queueName,
        eventType: QueueEventType.JOIN,
        eventTime: new Date(),
        positionNo: event.Position ? Number(event.Position) : null,
        rawPayload: event as any,
      },
    });

    this.realtime.emitTenant(tenantId, 'call.updated', {
      callId: call.callId,
      linkedid,
      sessionStatus: SessionStatus.QUEUED,
      queueName,
    });
  }

  private async handleAgentCalled(tenantId: string, linkedid: string, event: AmiEvent) {
    const call = await this.ensureSession(tenantId, linkedid, event);
    const extension = event.Interface?.match(/(\d+)/)?.[1];
    const agent = extension
      ? await this.prisma.agent.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, extension } })
      : null;

    await this.prisma.callSession.update({
      where: { callId: call.callId },
      data: {
        sessionStatus: SessionStatus.RINGING_AGENT,
        primaryAgentId: agent?.agentId,
        ringingAt: new Date(),
      },
    });

    await this.prisma.queueEvent.create({
      data: {
        callId: call.callId,
        tenantId,
        linkedid,
        queueName: call.queueName ?? event.Queue ?? 'sales',
        agentId: agent?.agentId,
        eventType: QueueEventType.AGENT_CALLED,
        eventTime: new Date(),
        rawPayload: event as any,
      },
    });

    if (agent) {
      await this.agentStateService.updateStatus({
        tenantId,
        agentId: agent.agentId,
        statusCode: AgentStatusCode.RINGING,
        sourceType: 'system',
      });
    }

    this.realtime.emitTenant(tenantId, 'call.updated', {
      callId: call.callId,
      linkedid,
      sessionStatus: SessionStatus.RINGING_AGENT,
      agentId: agent?.agentId ?? null,
    });
  }

  private async handleTalking(tenantId: string, linkedid: string, event: AmiEvent) {
    const call = await this.ensureSession(tenantId, linkedid, event);

    const updated = await this.prisma.callSession.update({
      where: { callId: call.callId },
      data: {
        sessionStatus: SessionStatus.TALKING,
        answeredAt: call.answeredAt ?? new Date(),
      },
    });

    if (updated.primaryAgentId) {
      await this.agentStateService.updateStatus({
        tenantId,
        agentId: updated.primaryAgentId,
        statusCode: AgentStatusCode.TALKING,
        sourceType: 'system',
      });
    }

    await this.prisma.queueEvent.create({
      data: {
        callId: call.callId,
        tenantId,
        linkedid,
        queueName: updated.queueName ?? 'sales',
        agentId: updated.primaryAgentId,
        eventType: QueueEventType.AGENT_CONNECT,
        eventTime: new Date(),
        rawPayload: event as any,
      },
    });

    this.realtime.emitTenant(tenantId, 'call.updated', {
      callId: call.callId,
      linkedid,
      sessionStatus: SessionStatus.TALKING,
      agentId: updated.primaryAgentId,
      answeredAt: updated.answeredAt,
    });
  }

  private async handleHold(tenantId: string, linkedid: string) {
    const session = await this.prisma.callSession.findUnique({
      where: { tenantId_linkedid: { tenantId, linkedid } },
    });
    if (!session) return;

    await this.prisma.callSession.update({
      where: { callId: session.callId },
      data: { sessionStatus: SessionStatus.HOLD },
    });

    this.realtime.emitTenant(tenantId, 'call.updated', {
      callId: session.callId,
      linkedid,
      sessionStatus: SessionStatus.HOLD,
    });
  }

  private async handleUnhold(tenantId: string, linkedid: string) {
    const session = await this.prisma.callSession.findUnique({
      where: { tenantId_linkedid: { tenantId, linkedid } },
    });
    if (!session) return;

    await this.prisma.callSession.update({
      where: { callId: session.callId },
      data: { sessionStatus: SessionStatus.TALKING },
    });

    this.realtime.emitTenant(tenantId, 'call.updated', {
      callId: session.callId,
      linkedid,
      sessionStatus: SessionStatus.TALKING,
    });
  }

  private async handleTransfer(tenantId: string, linkedid: string, event: AmiEvent) {
    const session = await this.prisma.callSession.findUnique({
      where: { tenantId_linkedid: { tenantId, linkedid } },
    });
    if (!session) return;

    const transferType =
      event.Event === 'AttendedTransfer' ? TransferType.attended : TransferType.blind;

    const fromExtension =
      event.TransfererChannel?.match(/PJSIP\/(\d+)/)?.[1] ?? null;
    const toExtension =
      event.TransfereeChannel?.match(/PJSIP\/(\d+)/)?.[1] ??
      event.Exten ??
      null;

    const fromAgent = fromExtension
      ? await this.prisma.agent.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, extension: fromExtension } })
      : null;
    const toAgent = toExtension
      ? await this.prisma.agent.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, extension: toExtension } })
      : null;

    await this.prisma.callSession.update({
      where: { callId: session.callId },
      data: {
        sessionStatus: SessionStatus.TRANSFERRING,
        transferFlag: true,
      },
    });

    await this.prisma.callTransfer.create({
      data: {
        callId: session.callId,
        tenantId,
        linkedid,
        transferType,
        fromAgentId: fromAgent?.agentId,
        toAgentId: toAgent?.agentId,
        fromExtension,
        toExtension,
        transferResult: TransferResult.completed,
        requestedAt: new Date(),
        completedAt: new Date(),
      },
    });

    this.realtime.emitTenant(tenantId, 'call.updated', {
      callId: session.callId,
      linkedid,
      sessionStatus: SessionStatus.TRANSFERRING,
      transferType,
      fromAgentId: fromAgent?.agentId ?? null,
      toAgentId: toAgent?.agentId ?? null,
    });
  }

  private async handleAgentComplete(tenantId: string, linkedid: string, event: AmiEvent) {
    const session = await this.prisma.callSession.findUnique({
      where: { tenantId_linkedid: { tenantId, linkedid } },
    });
    if (!session) return;

    await this.prisma.callSession.update({
      where: { callId: session.callId },
      data: {
        sessionStatus: SessionStatus.AFTER_CALL_WORK,
      },
    });

    await this.prisma.queueEvent.create({
      data: {
        callId: session.callId,
        tenantId,
        linkedid,
        queueName: session.queueName ?? 'sales',
        agentId: session.primaryAgentId,
        eventType: QueueEventType.AGENT_COMPLETE,
        eventTime: new Date(),
        ringSeconds: event.RingTime ? Number(event.RingTime) : 0,
        waitSeconds: event.HoldTime ? Number(event.HoldTime) : 0,
        rawPayload: event as any,
      },
    });

    if (session.primaryAgentId) {
      await this.agentStateService.updateStatus({
        tenantId,
        agentId: session.primaryAgentId,
        statusCode: AgentStatusCode.AFTER_CALL_WORK,
        sourceType: 'system',
      });
    }

    this.realtime.emitTenant(tenantId, 'call.updated', {
      callId: session.callId,
      linkedid,
      sessionStatus: SessionStatus.AFTER_CALL_WORK,
    });
  }

  private async handleHangup(tenantId: string, linkedid: string, event: AmiEvent) {
    const session = await this.prisma.callSession.findUnique({
      where: { tenantId_linkedid: { tenantId, linkedid } },
    });
    if (!session) return;

    const endedAt = new Date();
    const talkSeconds =
      session.answeredAt
        ? Math.max(0, Math.floor((endedAt.getTime() - session.answeredAt.getTime()) / 1000))
        : 0;

    await this.prisma.callSession.update({
      where: { callId: session.callId },
      data: {
        sessionStatus: SessionStatus.ENDED,
        endedAt,
        talkSeconds,
        abandonFlag: !session.answeredAt,
      },
    });

    if (event.Uniqueid) {
      await this.prisma.callLeg.updateMany({
        where: {
          tenantId,
          uniqueid: event.Uniqueid,
          endedAt: null,
        },
        data: {
          endedAt,
          durationSeconds: talkSeconds,
        },
      });
    }

    if (session.primaryAgentId) {
      await this.agentStateService.updateStatus({
        tenantId,
        agentId: session.primaryAgentId,
        statusCode: AgentStatusCode.AVAILABLE,
        sourceType: 'system',
      });
    }

    this.realtime.emitTenant(tenantId, 'call.ended', {
      callId: session.callId,
      linkedid,
      endedAt,
      talkSeconds,
      abandonFlag: !session.answeredAt,
    });
  }
}
```

```ts
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { AgentStatusCode, SessionStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';

@Injectable()
export class QueueSummaryService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  async getSummary(tenantId: string) {
    const queues = await this.prisma.queue.findMany({
      where: { tenantId, isActive: true },
      orderBy: { queueName: 'asc' },
    });

    return Promise.all(
      queues.map(async (queue) => {
        const waitingCount = await this.prisma.callSession.count({
          where: {
            tenantId,
            queueName: queue.queueName,
            sessionStatus: SessionStatus.QUEUED,
          },
        });

        const ringingCount = await this.prisma.callSession.count({
          where: {
            tenantId,
            queueName: queue.queueName,
            sessionStatus: SessionStatus.RINGING_AGENT,
          },
        });

        const talkingCount = await this.prisma.callSession.count({
          where: {
            tenantId,
            queueName: queue.queueName,
            sessionStatus: SessionStatus.TALKING,
          },
        });

        const activeMembers = await this.prisma.queueAgentMember.count({
          where: {
            queueId: queue.queueId,
            isActive: true,
          },
        });

        const availableAgents = await this.prisma.agentStatusHistory.count({
          where: {
            tenantId,
            endedAt: null,
            statusCode: AgentStatusCode.AVAILABLE,
            agent: {
              queueMembers: {
                some: {
                  queueId: queue.queueId,
                  isActive: true,
                },
              },
            },
          },
        });

        return {
          queueId: queue.queueId,
          queueName: queue.queueName,
          queueDisplayName: queue.queueDisplayName,
          waitingCount,
          ringingCount,
          talkingCount,
          activeMembers,
          availableAgents,
        };
      }),
    );
  }
}
```

```ts
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { AmiTcpClient } from '../ami/ami-tcp.client';

@Injectable()
export class OriginateService {
  constructor(private readonly amiClient: AmiTcpClient) {}

  async originate(params: {
    channel: string;
    extension: string;
    targetNumber: string;
    callerId: string;
    variable?: Record<string, string>;
  }) {
    const vars = {
      TARGET_NUMBER: params.targetNumber,
      ...params.variable,
    };

    const variableString = Object.entries(vars)
      .map(([k, v]) => `${k}=${v}`)
      .join('|');

    this.amiClient.action({
      Action: 'Originate',
      Channel: params.channel,
      Context: process.env.ASTERISK_ORIGINATE_CONTEXT ?? 'from-internal',
      Exten: params.targetNumber,
      Priority: 1,
      CallerID: params.callerId,
      Async: 'true',
      Variable: variableString,
    });

    return {
      requested: true,
      channel: params.channel,
      targetNumber: params.targetNumber,
    };
  }
}
```

```ts
@Injectable()
export class TransferService {
  constructor(private readonly amiClient: AmiTcpClient) {}

  async blindTransfer(channel: string, target: string, context = 'from-internal') {
    this.amiClient.action({
      Action: 'Redirect',
      Channel: channel,
      Context: context,
      Exten: target,
      Priority: 1,
    });

    return { requested: true, type: 'blind', target };
  }

  async attendedTransfer(channel: string, target: string) {
    this.amiClient.action({
      Action: 'Atxfer',
      Channel: channel,
      Exten: target,
      Context: 'from-internal',
      Priority: 1,
    });

    return { requested: true, type: 'attended', target };
  }

  async hangup(channel: string) {
    this.amiClient.action({
      Action: 'Hangup',
      Channel: channel,
    });

    return { requested: true };
  }
}
```

```ts
import { Injectable, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { OriginateService } from './originate.service';
import { TransferService } from './transfer.service';

@Injectable()
export class CallsService {
  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly originateService: OriginateService,
    private readonly transferService: TransferService,
  ) {}

  async getActiveCalls(tenantId: string) {
    return this.prisma.callSession.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        sessionStatus: {
          in: ['NEW', 'IVR', 'QUEUED', 'RINGING_AGENT', 'TALKING', 'HOLD', 'TRANSFERRING', 'AFTER_CALL_WORK'],
        },
      },
      include: {
        customer: true,
        primaryAgent: true,
      },
      orderBy: { startedAt: 'desc' },
    });
  }

  async getCallDetail(tenantId: string, callId: string) {
    const call = await this.prisma.callSession.findFirst({
      where: { tenantId, callId },
      include: {
        customer: true,
        primaryAgent: true,
        legs: true,
        memos: true,
        transfers: true,
      },
    });

    if (!call) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Call not found');
    }

    return call;
  }

  async saveMemo(
    tenantId: string,
    callId: string,
    agentId: string,
    input: {
      resultCode?: string;
      subResultCode?: string;
      memoText?: string;
      isFinal?: boolean;
    },
  ) {
    const call = await this.prisma.callSession.findFirst({
      where: { tenantId, callId },
    });
    if (!call) throw new NotFoundException('Call not found');

    return this.prisma.callMemo.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        callId,
        agentId,
        customerId: call.customerId,
        resultCode: input.resultCode,
        subResultCode: input.subResultCode,
        memoText: input.memoText,
        isFinal: input.isFinal ?? true,
      },
    });
  }

  async originate(
    tenantId: string,
    agentId: string,
    input: { extension: string; targetNumber: string; customerId?: string },
  ) {
    const agent = await this.prisma.agent.findFirst({
      where: { tenantId, agentId },
    });
    if (!agent) throw new NotFoundException('Agent not found');

    return this.originateService.originate({
      channel: `PJSIP/${input.extension}`,
      extension: input.extension,
      targetNumber: input.targetNumber,
      callerId: `${agent.agentName} <${input.extension}>`,
      variable: {
        TENANT_ID: tenantId,
        AGENT_ID: agentId,
        CUSTOMER_ID: input.customerId ?? '',
        ORIGINATE_MODE: 'click_to_call',
      },
    });
  }

  async transfer(
    tenantId: string,
    callId: string,
    input: {
      transferType: 'blind' | 'attended';
      targetType: 'extension' | 'queue' | 'external';
      target: string;
    },
  ) {
    const call = await this.prisma.callSession.findFirst({
      where: { tenantId, callId },
      include: { legs: true },
    });
    if (!call) throw new NotFoundException('Call not found');

    const activeLeg = call.legs.find((leg) => !leg.endedAt && leg.channelName);
    if (!activeLeg?.channelName) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Active channel not found');
    }

    if (input.transferType === 'blind') {
      return this.transferService.blindTransfer(activeLeg.channelName, input.target);
    }

    return this.transferService.attendedTransfer(activeLeg.channelName, input.target);
  }

  async hangup(tenantId: string, callId: string) {
    const call = await this.prisma.callSession.findFirst({
      where: { tenantId, callId },
      include: { legs: true },
    });
    if (!call) throw new NotFoundException('Call not found');

    const activeLeg = call.legs.find((leg) => !leg.endedAt && leg.channelName);
    if (!activeLeg?.channelName) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Active channel not found');
    }

    return this.transferService.hangup(activeLeg.channelName);
  }
}
```

## 26) 이 완성판의 핵심 보강점

이번 저장소 버전은 이전에 이어붙이기 좋도록 아래를 이미 반영한 형태다.

- **AMI TCP client 실동작**
  - net socket 기반 로그인
  - `\r\n\r\n` 단위 파싱
  - 자동 재접속

- **Session Engine 실동작**
  - `raw_ami_events` 원본 적재
  - `linkedid` 기준 `call_sessions` 생성
  - `call_legs`, `queue_events` 정규화
  - `QueueCallerJoin → AgentCalled → AgentConnect/BridgeEnter → Hangup → AgentComplete` 처리

- **상담원 상태 서비스**
  - 열린 상태 이력 자동 종료
  - 새 상태 히스토리 생성
  - 실시간 브로드캐스트

- **Transfer 정규화**
  - `AttendedTransfer`, `BlindTransfer`를 `call_transfers`에 저장
  - `call_sessions.transfer_flag`, `TRANSFERRING` 상태 반영

- **Queue summary 고도화**
  - waiting, ringing, talking, activeMembers, availableAgents 집계

- **Swagger/API 정식화**
  - 로그인, 세션, 상태 변경, 활성 콜, 메모, originate, transfer, hangup, queue summary

# 7) src/asterisk/ami/ami-tcp.client.ts

AMI는 설계서에서 **originate / hangup / transfer 등 콜 제어를 미들웨어가 PBX로 위임**하는 핵심 경로로 정의되어 있습니다. fileciteturn0file1L180-L188

```ts
import {
  Injectable,
  Logger,
  OnModuleDestroy,
  OnModuleInit,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import * as net from 'net';
import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';
import { AmiActionResponse, AmiEventMap, AmiOriginateParams } from './ami.types';

@Injectable()
export class AmiTcpClient extends EventEmitter implements OnModuleInit, OnModuleDestroy {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(AmiTcpClient.name);
  private socket: net.Socket | null = null;
  private buffer = '';
  private reconnectTimer: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;

  private readonly host = process.env.AMI_HOST ?? '127.0.0.1';
  private readonly port = Number(process.env.AMI_PORT ?? 5038);
  private readonly username = process.env.AMI_USERNAME ?? 'cti_middleware';
  private readonly secret = process.env.AMI_SECRET ?? 'STRONG_AMI_PASSWORD';

  private readonly pendingActions = new Map<
    string,
    { resolve: (value: AmiActionResponse) => void; reject: (reason?: unknown) => void; timer: NodeJS.Timeout }
  >();

  async onModuleInit(): Promise<void> {
    await this.connect();
  }

  async onModuleDestroy(): Promise<void> {
    this.socket?.destroy();
    if (this.reconnectTimer) clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimer);
  }

  private async connect(): Promise<void> {
    await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      const socket = net.createConnection(
        { host: this.host, port: this.port },
        () => {
          this.logger.log(`Connected to AMI ${this.host}:${this.port}`);
          this.socket = socket;
          this.login().finally(resolve);
        },
      );

      socket.setEncoding('utf8');

      socket.on('data', (chunk: string) => {
        this.buffer += chunk;
        this.flushFrames();
      });

      socket.on('error', (error) => {
        this.logger.error(`AMI socket error: ${error.message}`);
      });

      socket.on('close', () => {
        this.logger.warn('AMI socket closed');
        this.socket = null;
        this.scheduleReconnect();
      });
    });
  }

  private scheduleReconnect(): void {
    if (this.reconnectTimer) return;
    this.reconnectTimer = setTimeout(async () => {
      this.reconnectTimer = null;
      await this.connect();
    }, 3000);
  }

  private flushFrames(): void {
    let delimiterIndex = this.buffer.indexOf('\r\n\r\n');
    while (delimiterIndex >= 0) {
      const rawFrame = this.buffer.slice(0, delimiterIndex);
      this.buffer = this.buffer.slice(delimiterIndex + 4);
      const frame = this.parseFrame(rawFrame);
      this.handleFrame(frame);
      delimiterIndex = this.buffer.indexOf('\r\n\r\n');
    }
  }

  private parseFrame(rawFrame: string): AmiEventMap {
    const result: AmiEventMap = {};
    for (const line of rawFrame.split('\r\n')) {
      const idx = line.indexOf(':');
      if (idx < 0) continue;
      const key = line.slice(0, idx).trim();
      const value = line.slice(idx + 1).trim();
      result[key] = value;
    }
    return result;
  }

  private handleFrame(frame: AmiEventMap): void {
    const actionId = frame.ActionID;
    if (actionId && this.pendingActions.has(actionId)) {
      const pending = this.pendingActions.get(actionId)!;
      if (frame.Response) {
        clearTimeout(pending.timer);
        pending.resolve({
          success: frame.Response === 'Success',
          actionId,
          message: frame.Message,
          raw: frame as Record<string, unknown>,
        });
        this.pendingActions.delete(actionId);
        return;
      }
    }

    if (frame.Event) {
      this.emit('ami.event', frame);
      this.emit(`ami.event.${frame.Event}`, frame);
    }
  }

  private write(action: Record<string, string | number | boolean | undefined>): void {
    if (!this.socket) {
      throw new Error('AMI socket is not connected');
    }

    const payload =
      Object.entries(action)
        .filter(([, value]) => value !== undefined)
        .map(([key, value]) => `${key}: ${String(value)}`)
        .join('\r\n') + '\r\n\r\n';

    this.socket.write(payload);
  }

  private async login(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const result = await this.sendAction({
        Action: 'Login',
        Username: this.username,
        Secret: this.secret,
        Events: 'on',
      });
      if (!result.success) {
        this.logger.error(`AMI login failed: ${result.message ?? 'unknown'}`);
      } else {
        this.logger.log('AMI login success');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`AMI login error: ${(error as Error).message}`);
    }
  }

  async sendAction(action: Record<string, string | number | boolean | undefined>): Promise<AmiActionResponse> {
    const actionId = String(action.ActionID ?? randomUUID());

    return new Promise<AmiActionResponse>((resolve, reject) => {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        this.pendingActions.delete(actionId);
        reject(new Error(`AMI action timeout: ${action.Action ?? 'unknown'}`));
      }, 10000);

      this.pendingActions.set(actionId, { resolve, reject, timer });

      this.write({
        ...action,
        ActionID: actionId,
      });
    });
  }

  async originate(params: AmiOriginateParams): Promise<AmiActionResponse> {
    return this.sendAction({
      Action: 'Originate',
      Channel: params.channel,
      Context: params.context,
      Exten: params.exten,
      Priority: params.priority ?? 1,
      CallerID: params.callerId,
      Timeout: params.timeoutMs ?? 30000,
      Async: params.async ?? true,
      Variable: params.variable
        ? Object.entries(params.variable)
            .map(([k, v]) => `${k}=${v}`)
            .join(',')
        : undefined,
      ActionID: params.actionId,
    });
  }

  async hangup(channel: string): Promise<AmiActionResponse> {
    return this.sendAction({
      Action: 'Hangup',
      Channel: channel,
    });
  }

  async redirect(params: {
    channel: string;
    extraChannel?: string;
    context: string;
    exten: string;
    priority?: number;
  }): Promise<AmiActionResponse> {
    return this.sendAction({
      Action: 'Redirect',
      Channel: params.channel,
      ExtraChannel: params.extraChannel,
      Context: params.context,
      Exten: params.exten,
      Priority: params.priority ?? 1,
    });
  }
}
```

```ts
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import {
  AgentCurrentState,
  AgentStateSourceType,
  AgentStatusCode,
  Prisma,
} from '@prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../../prisma/prisma.service';
import { RealtimeGateway } from '../gateway/realtime.gateway';

@Injectable()
export class AgentStateService {
  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly realtimeGateway: RealtimeGateway,
  ) {}

  async setStatus(params: {
    tenantId: string;
    agentId: string;
    statusCode: AgentStatusCode;
    reasonCode?: string;
    reasonText?: string;
    sourceType?: AgentStateSourceType;
    changedAt?: Date;
  }): Promise<AgentCurrentState> {
    const changedAt = params.changedAt ?? new Date();
    const sourceType = params.sourceType ?? AgentStateSourceType.system;

    return this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const current = await tx.agentCurrentState.findUnique({
        where: { agentId: params.agentId },
      });

      if (current?.lastStatusHistoryId) {
        const durationSeconds = Math.max(
          0,
          Math.floor((changedAt.getTime() - new Date(current.changedAt).getTime()) / 1000),
        );

        await tx.agentStatusHistory.update({
          where: { statusHistoryId: current.lastStatusHistoryId },
          data: {
            endedAt: changedAt,
            durationSeconds,
          },
        });
      }

      const history = await tx.agentStatusHistory.create({
        data: {
          tenantId: params.tenantId,
          agentId: params.agentId,
          statusCode: params.statusCode,
          reasonCode: params.reasonCode,
          reasonText: params.reasonText,
          sourceType,
          startedAt: changedAt,
        },
      });

      const nextState = await tx.agentCurrentState.upsert({
        where: { agentId: params.agentId },
        update: {
          tenantId: params.tenantId,
          statusCode: params.statusCode,
          reasonCode: params.reasonCode ?? null,
          reasonText: params.reasonText ?? null,
          sourceType,
          changedAt,
          lastStatusHistoryId: history.statusHistoryId,
        },
        create: {
          agentId: params.agentId,
          tenantId: params.tenantId,
          statusCode: params.statusCode,
          reasonCode: params.reasonCode ?? null,
          reasonText: params.reasonText ?? null,
          sourceType,
          changedAt,
          lastStatusHistoryId: history.statusHistoryId,
        },
      });

      this.realtimeGateway.broadcast('agent.status.changed', {
        agentId: params.agentId,
        statusCode: nextState.statusCode,
        reasonCode: nextState.reasonCode,
        reasonText: nextState.reasonText,
        changedAt: nextState.changedAt,
      });

      return nextState;
    });
  }

  async getCurrentState(agentId: string): Promise<AgentCurrentState | null> {
    return this.prisma.agentCurrentState.findUnique({
      where: { agentId },
    });
  }

  async bulkSyncFromActiveCalls(tenantId: string): Promise<void> {
    const talkingAgents = await this.prisma.callSession.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        sessionStatus: 'TALKING',
        primaryAgentId: { not: null },
        endedAt: null,
      },
      select: { primaryAgentId: true },
      distinct: ['primaryAgentId'],
    });

    const talkingIds = new Set(
      talkingAgents
        .map((x) => x.primaryAgentId)
        .filter((v): v is string => !!v),
    );

    const allAgents = await this.prisma.agent.findMany({
      where: { tenantId, isActive: true },
      select: { agentId: true },
    });

    for (const agent of allAgents) {
      const status = talkingIds.has(agent.agentId)
        ? AgentStatusCode.TALKING
        : AgentStatusCode.AVAILABLE;

      await this.setStatus({
        tenantId,
        agentId: agent.agentId,
        statusCode: status,
        sourceType: AgentStateSourceType.system,
      });
    }
  }

  buildPauseStatus(input: string): AgentStatusCode {
    const normalized = input.toUpperCase();
    const map: Record<string, AgentStatusCode> = {
      BREAK: AgentStatusCode.BREAK,
      MEAL: AgentStatusCode.MEAL,
      TRAINING: AgentStatusCode.TRAINING,
      MANUAL_PAUSED: AgentStatusCode.MANUAL_PAUSED,
      SYSTEM_PAUSED: AgentStatusCode.SYSTEM_PAUSED,
      AVAILABLE: AgentStatusCode.AVAILABLE,
    };
    return map[normalized] ?? AgentStatusCode.MANUAL_PAUSED;
  }

  async setStatusByExtension(params: {
    tenantId: string;
    extension: string;
    statusCode: AgentStatusCode;
    reasonCode?: string;
    reasonText?: string;
    sourceType?: AgentStateSourceType;
  }): Promise<AgentCurrentState> {
    const agent = await this.prisma.agent.findFirst({
      where: {
        tenantId: params.tenantId,
        extension: params.extension,
        isActive: true,
      },
    });

    if (!agent) {
      throw new Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError(
        `Agent not found by extension: ${params.extension}`,
        { code: 'P2025', clientVersion: 'unknown' },
      );
    }

    return this.setStatus({
      tenantId: params.tenantId,
      agentId: agent.agentId,
      statusCode: params.statusCode,
      reasonCode: params.reasonCode,
      reasonText: params.reasonText,
      sourceType: params.sourceType,
    });
  }
}
```

```ts
import { BadRequestException, Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { OriginateRequestStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';
import { PrismaService } from '../../prisma/prisma.service';
import { AmiTcpClient } from '../ami/ami-tcp.client';
import { RealtimeGateway } from '../gateway/realtime.gateway';
import { OriginateCallDto } from '../dto/originate-call.dto';

@Injectable()
export class OriginateService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(OriginateService.name);

  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly amiClient: AmiTcpClient,
    private readonly realtimeGateway: RealtimeGateway,
  ) {}

  async originateForAgent(params: {
    tenantId: string;
    agentId: string;
    dto: OriginateCallDto;
  }) {
    const agent = await this.prisma.agent.findFirst({
      where: {
        agentId: params.agentId,
        tenantId: params.tenantId,
        isActive: true,
      },
    });

    if (!agent) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Agent not found');
    }

    if (!agent.extension) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Agent extension is missing');
    }

    const activeTalking = await this.prisma.callSession.count({
      where: {
        tenantId: params.tenantId,
        primaryAgentId: agent.agentId,
        endedAt: null,
        sessionStatus: {
          in: ['RINGING_AGENT', 'TALKING', 'TRANSFERRING'],
        },
      },
    });

    if (activeTalking > 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Agent already has an active call');
    }

    const requestKey = randomUUID();
    const actionId = `originate:${requestKey}`;

    const originateRequest = await this.prisma.originateRequest.create({
      data: {
        tenantId: params.tenantId,
        agentId: agent.agentId,
        requestKey,
        extension: params.dto.extension,
        targetNumber: params.dto.targetNumber,
        trunkName: params.dto.trunkName ?? null,
        context: params.dto.context ?? 'outbound-main',
        exten: params.dto.exten ?? 'dial-external',
        priority: 1,
        callerId: params.dto.callerId ?? `${agent.agentName} <${agent.extension}>`,
        timeoutMs: params.dto.timeoutMs ?? 30000,
        actionId,
        variableJson: {
          tenantId: params.tenantId,
          agentId: agent.agentId,
          agentExtension: agent.extension,
          targetNumber: params.dto.targetNumber,
          requestKey,
          requestType: 'click_to_call',
        },
        status: OriginateRequestStatus.requested,
      },
    });

    const channel = `PJSIP/${agent.extension}`;
    const variable = {
      __TENANT_ID: params.tenantId,
      __AGENT_ID: agent.agentId,
      __AGENT_EXTEN: agent.extension,
      __ORIGINATE_REQUEST_KEY: requestKey,
      __TARGET_NUMBER: params.dto.targetNumber,
      __TRUNK_NAME: params.dto.trunkName ?? '',
      __CALL_FLOW: 'CLICK_TO_CALL',
    };

    const result = await this.amiClient.originate({
      channel,
      context: params.dto.context ?? 'outbound-main',
      exten: params.dto.exten ?? 'dial-external',
      priority: 1,
      callerId: params.dto.callerId ?? `${agent.agentName} <${agent.extension}>`,
      timeoutMs: params.dto.timeoutMs ?? 30000,
      async: true,
      actionId,
      variable,
    });

    const nextStatus = result.success
      ? OriginateRequestStatus.sent
      : OriginateRequestStatus.failed;

    const updated = await this.prisma.originateRequest.update({
      where: { originateRequestId: originateRequest.originateRequestId },
      data: {
        status: nextStatus,
        sentAt: result.success ? new Date() : null,
        failReason: result.success ? null : result.message ?? 'AMI originate failed',
      },
    });

    this.logger.log(
      `Originate request ${updated.originateRequestId} status=${updated.status} target=${updated.targetNumber}`,
    );

    this.realtimeGateway.broadcast('call.originate.requested', {
      originateRequestId: updated.originateRequestId,
      agentId: updated.agentId,
      extension: updated.extension,
      targetNumber: updated.targetNumber,
      status: updated.status,
    });

    return updated;
  }

  async markLinkedidByRequestKey(requestKey: string, linkedid: string, callId?: string): Promise<void> {
    const req = await this.prisma.originateRequest.findUnique({
      where: { requestKey },
    });
    if (!req) return;

    await this.prisma.originateRequest.update({
      where: { originateRequestId: req.originateRequestId },
      data: {
        linkedid,
        callId,
      },
    });
  }

  async transitionByLinkedid(linkedid: string, status: OriginateRequestStatus): Promise<void> {
    const latest = await this.prisma.originateRequest.findFirst({
      where: { linkedid },
      orderBy: { requestedAt: 'desc' },
    });

    if (!latest) return;

    const now = new Date();
    await this.prisma.originateRequest.update({
      where: { originateRequestId: latest.originateRequestId },
      data: {
        status,
        agentAnsweredAt:
          status === OriginateRequestStatus.agent_answered ? now : undefined,
        targetDialingAt:
          status === OriginateRequestStatus.target_dialing ? now : undefined,
        bridgedAt:
          status === OriginateRequestStatus.bridged ? now : undefined,
        endedAt:
          status === OriginateRequestStatus.completed ||
          status === OriginateRequestStatus.failed ||
          status === OriginateRequestStatus.cancelled
            ? now
            : undefined,
      },
    });
  }
}
```

```ts
import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { TransferResult, TransferType } from '@prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../../prisma/prisma.service';
import { RealtimeGateway } from '../gateway/realtime.gateway';

@Injectable()
export class AttendedTransferResolverService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(AttendedTransferResolverService.name);

  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly realtimeGateway: RealtimeGateway,
  ) {}

  async markTransferStarted(params: {
    tenantId: string;
    callId: string;
    linkedid: string;
    fromAgentId?: string | null;
    fromExtension?: string | null;
    toAgentId?: string | null;
    toExtension?: string | null;
    originalChannel?: string | null;
    consultChannel?: string | null;
    originalUniqueid?: string | null;
    consultUniqueid?: string | null;
    bridgeIdBefore?: string | null;
  }): Promise<void> {
    await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.callSession.update({
        where: {
          tenantId_linkedid: {
            tenantId: params.tenantId,
            linkedid: params.linkedid,
          },
        },
        data: {
          sessionStatus: 'TRANSFERRING',
          transferFlag: true,
        },
      });

      await tx.callTransfer.create({
        data: {
          callId: params.callId,
          tenantId: params.tenantId,
          linkedid: params.linkedid,
          transferType: TransferType.attended,
          fromAgentId: params.fromAgentId ?? null,
          toAgentId: params.toAgentId ?? null,
          fromExtension: params.fromExtension ?? null,
          toExtension: params.toExtension ?? null,
          transferResult: TransferResult.in_progress,
          requestedAt: new Date(),
        },
      });

      await tx.attendedTransferCandidate.create({
        data: {
          tenantId: params.tenantId,
          callId: params.callId,
          linkedid: params.linkedid,
          originalAgentId: params.fromAgentId ?? null,
          consultAgentId: params.toAgentId ?? null,
          originalChannel: params.originalChannel ?? null,
          consultChannel: params.consultChannel ?? null,
          originalUniqueid: params.originalUniqueid ?? null,
          consultUniqueid: params.consultUniqueid ?? null,
          bridgeIdBefore: params.bridgeIdBefore ?? null,
        },
      });
    });

    this.realtimeGateway.broadcast('call.transfer.started', {
      linkedid: params.linkedid,
      transferType: 'attended',
    });
  }

  async resolveCompleted(params: {
    tenantId: string;
    linkedid: string;
    toAgentId?: string | null;
    toExtension?: string | null;
    bridgeIdAfter?: string | null;
    note?: string;
  }): Promise<void> {
    const session = await this.prisma.callSession.findUnique({
      where: {
        tenantId_linkedid: {
          tenantId: params.tenantId,
          linkedid: params.linkedid,
        },
      },
    });

    if (!session) return;

    await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const candidate = await tx.attendedTransferCandidate.findFirst({
        where: {
          tenantId: params.tenantId,
          linkedid: params.linkedid,
          completedAt: null,
          cancelledAt: null,
        },
        orderBy: { startedAt: 'desc' },
      });

      if (candidate) {
        await tx.attendedTransferCandidate.update({
          where: { candidateId: candidate.candidateId },
          data: {
            completedAt: new Date(),
            bridgeIdAfter: params.bridgeIdAfter ?? null,
            resolutionNote: params.note ?? 'consult leg resolved to final bridge',
          },
        });
      }

      const transfer = await tx.callTransfer.findFirst({
        where: {
          tenantId: params.tenantId,
          linkedid: params.linkedid,
          transferType: TransferType.attended,
          transferResult: TransferResult.in_progress,
        },
        orderBy: { requestedAt: 'desc' },
      });

      if (transfer) {
        await tx.callTransfer.update({
          where: { transferId: transfer.transferId },
          data: {
            toAgentId: params.toAgentId ?? transfer.toAgentId,
            toExtension: params.toExtension ?? transfer.toExtension,
            transferResult: TransferResult.completed,
            completedAt: new Date(),
          },
        });
      }

      await tx.callSession.update({
        where: {
          tenantId_linkedid: {
            tenantId: params.tenantId,
            linkedid: params.linkedid,
          },
        },
        data: {
          primaryAgentId: params.toAgentId ?? session.primaryAgentId,
          sessionStatus: 'TALKING',
          transferFlag: true,
        },
      });
    });

    this.logger.log(`Attended transfer completed linkedid=${params.linkedid}`);
    this.realtimeGateway.broadcast('call.transfer.completed', {
      linkedid: params.linkedid,
      transferType: 'attended',
      toAgentId: params.toAgentId ?? null,
      toExtension: params.toExtension ?? null,
    });
  }

  async resolveCancelled(params: {
    tenantId: string;
    linkedid: string;
    note?: string;
  }): Promise<void> {
    await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const candidate = await tx.attendedTransferCandidate.findFirst({
        where: {
          tenantId: params.tenantId,
          linkedid: params.linkedid,
          completedAt: null,
          cancelledAt: null,
        },
        orderBy: { startedAt: 'desc' },
      });

      if (candidate) {
        await tx.attendedTransferCandidate.update({
          where: { candidateId: candidate.candidateId },
          data: {
            cancelledAt: new Date(),
            resolutionNote: params.note ?? 'consultation cancelled',
          },
        });
      }

      const transfer = await tx.callTransfer.findFirst({
        where: {
          tenantId: params.tenantId,
          linkedid: params.linkedid,
          transferType: TransferType.attended,
          transferResult: TransferResult.in_progress,
        },
        orderBy: { requestedAt: 'desc' },
      });

      if (transfer) {
        await tx.callTransfer.update({
          where: { transferId: transfer.transferId },
          data: {
            transferResult: TransferResult.cancelled,
          },
        });
      }

      await tx.callSession.updateMany({
        where: {
          tenantId: params.tenantId,
          linkedid: params.linkedid,
          sessionStatus: 'TRANSFERRING',
        },
        data: {
          sessionStatus: 'TALKING',
        },
      });
    });

    this.realtimeGateway.broadcast('call.transfer.cancelled', {
      linkedid: params.linkedid,
      transferType: 'attended',
    });
  }
}
```

```ts
import { BadRequestException, Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../../prisma/prisma.service';
import { AmiTcpClient } from '../ami/ami-tcp.client';
import { TransferCallDto } from '../dto/transfer-call.dto';
import { AttendedTransferResolverService } from './attended-transfer-resolver.service';

@Injectable()
export class CallCommandService {
  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly amiClient: AmiTcpClient,
    private readonly transferResolver: AttendedTransferResolverService,
  ) {}

  async hangupCall(params: { tenantId: string; callId: string }): Promise<{ ok: true }> {
    const legs = await this.prisma.callLeg.findMany({
      where: {
        callId: params.callId,
        tenantId: params.tenantId,
        endedAt: null,
      },
      orderBy: { startedAt: 'desc' },
    });

    for (const leg of legs) {
      if (leg.channelName) {
        await this.amiClient.hangup(leg.channelName);
      }
    }

    return { ok: true };
  }

  async transferCall(params: {
    tenantId: string;
    callId: string;
    requestingAgentId: string;
    dto: TransferCallDto;
  }): Promise<{ ok: true; mode: string }> {
    const call = await this.prisma.callSession.findFirst({
      where: {
        callId: params.callId,
        tenantId: params.tenantId,
        endedAt: null,
      },
    });

    if (!call) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Active call not found');
    }

    const liveAgentLeg = await this.prisma.callLeg.findFirst({
      where: {
        callId: call.callId,
        tenantId: params.tenantId,
        endedAt: null,
        agentId: params.requestingAgentId,
      },
      orderBy: { startedAt: 'desc' },
    });

    if (!liveAgentLeg?.channelName) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Active agent channel not found');
    }

    if (params.dto.transferType === 'blind') {
      const targetContext =
        params.dto.targetType === 'queue'
          ? 'queue-transfer'
          : params.dto.targetType === 'external'
            ? 'outbound-transfer'
            : 'agent-transfer';

      await this.amiClient.redirect({
        channel: liveAgentLeg.channelName,
        context: targetContext,
        exten: params.dto.target,
        priority: 1,
      });

      await this.prisma.callTransfer.create({
        data: {
          callId: call.callId,
          tenantId: params.tenantId,
          linkedid: call.linkedid,
          transferType: 'blind',
          fromAgentId: params.requestingAgentId,
          toExtension: params.dto.target,
          transferResult: 'requested',
          requestedAt: new Date(),
        },
      });

      await this.prisma.callSession.update({
        where: {
          tenantId_linkedid: {
            tenantId: params.tenantId,
            linkedid: call.linkedid,
          },
        },
        data: {
          sessionStatus: 'TRANSFERRING',
          transferFlag: true,
        },
      });

      return { ok: true, mode: 'blind' };
    }

    let targetAgentId: string | null = null;
    if (params.dto.targetType === 'extension') {
      const targetAgent = await this.prisma.agent.findFirst({
        where: {
          tenantId: params.tenantId,
          extension: params.dto.target,
          isActive: true,
        },
      });
      targetAgentId = targetAgent?.agentId ?? null;
    }

    await this.transferResolver.markTransferStarted({
      tenantId: params.tenantId,
      callId: call.callId,
      linkedid: call.linkedid,
      fromAgentId: params.requestingAgentId,
      toAgentId: targetAgentId,
      fromExtension: liveAgentLeg.endpoint ?? null,
      toExtension: params.dto.target,
      originalChannel: liveAgentLeg.channelName,
      originalUniqueid: liveAgentLeg.uniqueid,
    });

    await this.amiClient.originate({
      channel:
        params.dto.targetType === 'extension'
          ? `PJSIP/${params.dto.target}`
          : params.dto.targetType === 'external'
            ? `Local/${params.dto.target}@outbound-transfer`
            : `Local/${params.dto.target}@queue-transfer`,
      context: 'attended-transfer-consult',
      exten: params.dto.target,
      priority: 1,
      callerId: `Transfer <${params.dto.target}>`,
      timeoutMs: 20000,
      async: true,
      variable: {
        __TRANSFER_LINKEDID: call.linkedid,
        __TRANSFER_CALL_ID: call.callId,
        __TRANSFER_FROM_AGENT_ID: params.requestingAgentId,
        __TRANSFER_TO_TARGET: params.dto.target,
        __TRANSFER_TYPE: 'ATTENDED',
      },
    });

    return { ok: true, mode: 'attended' };
  }
}
```

```ts
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { AgentStatusCode, SessionStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../../prisma/prisma.service';

@Injectable()
export class QueueSummaryService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  async getSummary(tenantId: string) {
    const queues = await this.prisma.queue.findMany({
      where: { tenantId, isActive: true },
      orderBy: { queueName: 'asc' },
    });

    const queuedCalls = await this.prisma.callSession.groupBy({
      by: ['queueName', 'sessionStatus'],
      where: {
        tenantId,
        endedAt: null,
        queueName: { not: null },
        sessionStatus: {
          in: [SessionStatus.QUEUED, SessionStatus.RINGING_AGENT, SessionStatus.TALKING],
        },
      },
      _count: { _all: true },
    });

    const memberAgents = await this.prisma.queueAgentMember.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        isActive: true,
        queue: { isActive: true },
      },
      include: {
        agent: {
          include: {
            currentState: true,
          },
        },
        queue: true,
      },
    });

    return queues.map((queue) => {
      const waitingCount =
        queuedCalls.find(
          (x) => x.queueName === queue.queueName && x.sessionStatus === SessionStatus.QUEUED,
        )?._count._all ?? 0;

      const talkingCount =
        queuedCalls.find(
          (x) => x.queueName === queue.queueName && x.sessionStatus === SessionStatus.TALKING,
        )?._count._all ?? 0;

      const queueMembers = memberAgents.filter((m) => m.queueId === queue.queueId);

      const availableAgents = queueMembers.filter(
        (m) => m.agent.currentState?.statusCode === AgentStatusCode.AVAILABLE,
      ).length;

      const ringingAgents = queueMembers.filter(
        (m) => m.agent.currentState?.statusCode === AgentStatusCode.RINGING,
      ).length;

      const pausedAgents = queueMembers.filter((m) =>
        [
          AgentStatusCode.BREAK,
          AgentStatusCode.MEAL,
          AgentStatusCode.TRAINING,
          AgentStatusCode.MANUAL_PAUSED,
          AgentStatusCode.SYSTEM_PAUSED,
        ].includes(m.agent.currentState?.statusCode as AgentStatusCode),
      ).length;

      return {
        queueName: queue.queueName,
        waitingCount,
        talkingCount,
        availableAgents,
        ringingAgents,
        pausedAgents,
      };
    });
  }
}
```

```ts
      eventName: raw.Event ?? '',

      uniqueid: raw.Uniqueid ?? raw.UniqueID ?? null,
      channel: raw.Channel ?? null,
      destChannel: raw.DestChannel ?? null,

      connectedLineNum: raw.ConnectedLineNum ?? null,

      context: raw.Context ?? null,
      queue: raw.Queue ?? raw.QueueName ?? null,
      interface: raw.Interface ?? null,
      memberName: raw.MemberName ?? null,
      dialStatus: raw.DialStatus ?? null,
      transferMethod: raw.TransferMethod ?? null,
      transferType: raw.TransferType ?? null,
      raw,
    };
  }

  extractLinkedid(raw: AmiEventMap): string | null {
    return raw.Linkedid ?? raw.LinkedID ?? null;
  }

  extractUniqueid(raw: AmiEventMap): string | null {
    return raw.Uniqueid ?? raw.UniqueID ?? null;
  }

  extractEventTime(raw: AmiEventMap): Date {

    return new Date(ts);
```

```ts
import { Injectable, Logger, OnModuleInit } from '@nestjs/common';
import {
  AgentStateSourceType,
  AgentStatusCode,
  LegType,
  OriginateRequestStatus,
  SessionStatus,
} from '@prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../../prisma/prisma.service';
import { AmiTcpClient } from '../ami/ami-tcp.client';
import { AmiEventMap } from '../ami/ami.types';
import { RealtimeGateway } from '../gateway/realtime.gateway';
import { EventNormalizerService } from './event-normalizer.service';
import { AgentStateService } from '../services/agent-state.service';
import { OriginateService } from '../services/originate.service';
import { AttendedTransferResolverService } from '../services/attended-transfer-resolver.service';

@Injectable()
export class SessionEngineService implements OnModuleInit {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(SessionEngineService.name);
  private readonly tenantId = process.env.DEFAULT_TENANT_ID ?? '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';

  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly amiClient: AmiTcpClient,
    private readonly normalizer: EventNormalizerService,
    private readonly realtimeGateway: RealtimeGateway,
    private readonly agentStateService: AgentStateService,
    private readonly originateService: OriginateService,
    private readonly transferResolver: AttendedTransferResolverService,
  ) {}

  onModuleInit(): void {
    this.amiClient.on('ami.event', async (event: AmiEventMap) => {
      try {
        await this.handleEvent(event);
      } catch (error) {
        this.logger.error(`handleEvent failed: ${(error as Error).message}`);
      }
    });
  }

  private async persistRaw(event: AmiEventMap, callId?: string | null): Promise<void> {
    const linkedid = this.normalizer.extractLinkedid(event);
    const uniqueid = this.normalizer.extractUniqueid(event);

    await this.prisma.rawAmiEvent.create({
      data: {
        tenantId: this.tenantId,
        callId: callId ?? null,
        linkedid,
        uniqueid,
        eventName: event.Event ?? 'UNKNOWN',
        eventTime: this.normalizer.extractEventTime(event),
        payload: event as Record<string, unknown>,
      },
    });
  }

  private detectLegType(channelName?: string | null): LegType {
    if (!channelName) return LegType.local;
    if (channelName.startsWith('PJSIP/') && /-\d+/.test(channelName)) return LegType.agent;
    if (channelName.startsWith('Local/')) return LegType.local;
    return LegType.outbound;
  }

  private async ensureSession(linkedid: string, event: AmiEventMap) {
    const existing = await this.prisma.callSession.findUnique({
      where: {
        tenantId_linkedid: {
          tenantId: this.tenantId,
          linkedid,
        },
      },
    });
    if (existing) return existing;

    const ani = event.CallerIDNum ?? null;
    return this.prisma.callSession.create({
      data: {
        tenantId: this.tenantId,
        linkedid,
        direction: 'inbound',
        ani,
        aniNormalized: ani?.replace(/\D/g, '') ?? null,
        dnis: event.Exten ?? null,
        didNumber: event.Exten ?? null,
        sessionStatus: SessionStatus.NEW,
        startedAt: this.normalizer.extractEventTime(event),
      },
    });
  }

  private async ensureLeg(params: {
    callId: string;
    linkedid: string;
    uniqueid: string;
    channelName?: string | null;
    agentId?: string | null;
    endpoint?: string | null;
    stateCode?: string | null;
  }) {
    const existing = await this.prisma.callLeg.findFirst({
      where: {
        tenantId: this.tenantId,
        uniqueid: params.uniqueid,
      },
    });
    if (existing) return existing;

    return this.prisma.callLeg.create({
      data: {
        callId: params.callId,
        tenantId: this.tenantId,
        linkedid: params.linkedid,
        uniqueid: params.uniqueid,
        legType: this.detectLegType(params.channelName),
        channelName: params.channelName ?? null,
        endpoint: params.endpoint ?? null,
        agentId: params.agentId ?? null,
        stateCode: params.stateCode ?? null,
        startedAt: new Date(),
      },
    });
  }

  private async findAgentByChannelOrExten(channel?: string | null, exten?: string | null) {
    let guessedExtension: string | null = exten ?? null;

    if (!guessedExtension && channel?.startsWith('PJSIP/')) {
      guessedExtension = channel.split('/')[1]?.split('-')[0] ?? null;
    }

    if (!guessedExtension) return null;

    return this.prisma.agent.findFirst({
      where: {
        tenantId: this.tenantId,
        extension: guessedExtension,
      },
    });
  }

  async handleEvent(event: AmiEventMap): Promise<void> {
    const eventName = event.Event ?? 'UNKNOWN';
    const linkedid = this.normalizer.extractLinkedid(event);

    if (!linkedid) {
      await this.persistRaw(event, null);
      return;
    }

    const session = await this.ensureSession(linkedid, event);
    await this.persistRaw(event, session.callId);

    switch (eventName) {
      case 'Newchannel':
        await this.handleNewchannel(session.callId, linkedid, event);
        break;
      case 'QueueCallerJoin':
        await this.handleQueueJoin(session.callId, linkedid, event);
        break;
      case 'AgentCalled':
        await this.handleAgentCalled(session.callId, linkedid, event);
        break;
      case 'AgentConnect':
        await this.handleAgentConnect(session.callId, linkedid, event);
        break;
      case 'BridgeEnter':
        await this.handleBridgeEnter(session.callId, linkedid, event);
        break;
      case 'BridgeLeave':
        await this.handleBridgeLeave(session.callId, linkedid, event);
        break;
      case 'Hangup':
        await this.handleHangup(session.callId, linkedid, event);
        break;
      case 'AttendedTransfer':
      case 'BlindTransfer':
        await this.handleTransferRelated(session.callId, linkedid, event);
        break;
      case 'OriginateResponse':
        await this.handleOriginateResponse(session.callId, linkedid, event);
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
  }

  private async handleNewchannel(callId: string, linkedid: string, event: AmiEventMap): Promise<void> {
    const uniqueid = this.normalizer.extractUniqueid(event);
    if (!uniqueid) return;

    const agent = await this.findAgentByChannelOrExten(event.Channel);
    await this.ensureLeg({
      callId,
      linkedid,
      uniqueid,
      channelName: event.Channel ?? null,
      agentId: agent?.agentId ?? null,
      endpoint: agent?.extension ?? null,
      stateCode: event.ChannelStateDesc ?? null,
    });

    const requestKey = event.Variable?.includes('__ORIGINATE_REQUEST_KEY=')
      ? null
      : (event.ORIGINATE_REQUEST_KEY ?? event['__ORIGINATE_REQUEST_KEY'] ?? null);

    if (requestKey && typeof requestKey === 'string') {
      await this.originateService.markLinkedidByRequestKey(requestKey, linkedid, callId);
    }

    this.realtimeGateway.broadcast('call.updated', {
      callId,
      linkedid,
      sessionStatus: 'NEW',
    });
  }

  private async handleQueueJoin(callId: string, linkedid: string, event: AmiEventMap): Promise<void> {
    const queueName = event.Queue ?? event.QueueName ?? 'unknown';

    await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.callSession.update({
        where: {
          tenantId_linkedid: {
            tenantId: this.tenantId,
            linkedid,
          },
        },
        data: {
          queueName,
          sessionStatus: SessionStatus.QUEUED,
          queuedAt: new Date(),
        },
      });

      await tx.queueEvent.create({
        data: {
          callId,
          tenantId: this.tenantId,
          linkedid,
          queueName,
          eventType: 'JOIN',
          eventTime: new Date(),
          rawPayload: event as Record<string, unknown>,
        },
      });
    });

    this.realtimeGateway.broadcast('call.updated', {
      callId,
      linkedid,
      sessionStatus: 'QUEUED',
      queueName,
    });
  }

  private async handleAgentCalled(callId: string, linkedid: string, event: AmiEventMap): Promise<void> {
    const agent = await this.findAgentByChannelOrExten(event.Interface, event.MemberName);
    const queueName = event.Queue ?? 'unknown';

    await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.callSession.update({
        where: {
          tenantId_linkedid: {
            tenantId: this.tenantId,
            linkedid,
          },
        },
        data: {
          sessionStatus: SessionStatus.RINGING_AGENT,
          ringingAt: new Date(),
          primaryAgentId: agent?.agentId ?? undefined,
        },
      });

      await tx.queueEvent.create({
        data: {
          callId,
          tenantId: this.tenantId,
          linkedid,
          queueName,
          agentId: agent?.agentId ?? null,
          eventType: 'AGENT_CALLED',
          eventTime: new Date(),
          rawPayload: event as Record<string, unknown>,
        },
      });
    });

    if (agent) {
      await this.agentStateService.setStatus({
        tenantId: this.tenantId,
        agentId: agent.agentId,
        statusCode: AgentStatusCode.RINGING,
        sourceType: AgentStateSourceType.system,
      });
    }
  }

  private async handleAgentConnect(callId: string, linkedid: string, event: AmiEventMap): Promise<void> {
    const agent = await this.findAgentByChannelOrExten(event.Interface, event.MemberName);
    const queueName = event.Queue ?? 'unknown';

    await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.callSession.update({
        where: {
          tenantId_linkedid: {
            tenantId: this.tenantId,
            linkedid,
          },
        },
        data: {
          sessionStatus: SessionStatus.TALKING,
          primaryAgentId: agent?.agentId ?? undefined,
          answeredAt: new Date(),
        },
      });

      await tx.queueEvent.create({
        data: {
          callId,
          tenantId: this.tenantId,
          linkedid,
          queueName,
          agentId: agent?.agentId ?? null,
          eventType: 'AGENT_CONNECT',
          eventTime: new Date(),
          rawPayload: event as Record<string, unknown>,
        },
      });
    });

    if (agent) {
      await this.agentStateService.setStatus({
        tenantId: this.tenantId,
        agentId: agent.agentId,
        statusCode: AgentStatusCode.TALKING,
        sourceType: AgentStateSourceType.system,
      });
    }

    await this.originateService.transitionByLinkedid(linkedid, OriginateRequestStatus.agent_answered);
  }

  private async handleBridgeEnter(callId: string, linkedid: string, event: AmiEventMap): Promise<void> {
    await this.prisma.callSession.update({
      where: {
        tenantId_linkedid: {
          tenantId: this.tenantId,
          linkedid,
        },
      },
      data: {
        sessionStatus: SessionStatus.TALKING,
        answeredAt: new Date(),
      },
    });

    const candidate = await this.prisma.attendedTransferCandidate.findFirst({
      where: {
        tenantId: this.tenantId,
        linkedid,
        completedAt: null,
        cancelledAt: null,
      },
      orderBy: { startedAt: 'desc' },
    });

    if (candidate) {
      const targetAgent = await this.findAgentByChannelOrExten(event.Channel);
      await this.transferResolver.resolveCompleted({
        tenantId: this.tenantId,
        linkedid,
        toAgentId: targetAgent?.agentId ?? candidate.consultAgentId ?? null,
        toExtension: targetAgent?.extension ?? null,
        bridgeIdAfter: event.BridgeUniqueid ?? null,
        note: 'BridgeEnter resolved final consult handoff',
      });
    }

    await this.originateService.transitionByLinkedid(linkedid, OriginateRequestStatus.bridged);
  }

  private async handleBridgeLeave(callId: string, linkedid: string, event: AmiEventMap): Promise<void> {
    const openCandidate = await this.prisma.attendedTransferCandidate.findFirst({
      where: {
        tenantId: this.tenantId,
        linkedid,
        completedAt: null,
        cancelledAt: null,
      },
      orderBy: { startedAt: 'desc' },
    });

    if (openCandidate && event.Channel === openCandidate.consultChannel) {
      await this.transferResolver.resolveCancelled({
        tenantId: this.tenantId,
        linkedid,
        note: 'Consult leg left bridge before final completion',
      });
    }

    await this.prisma.callSession.updateMany({
      where: {
        tenantId: this.tenantId,
        linkedid,
        sessionStatus: SessionStatus.TALKING,
      },
      data: {
        sessionStatus: SessionStatus.HOLD,
      },
    });
  }

  private async handleHangup(callId: string, linkedid: string, event: AmiEventMap): Promise<void> {
    const uniqueid = this.normalizer.extractUniqueid(event);
    if (uniqueid) {
      await this.prisma.callLeg.updateMany({
        where: {
          tenantId: this.tenantId,
          uniqueid,
          endedAt: null,
        },
        data: {
          endedAt: new Date(),
          disposition: event.CauseTxt ?? null,
        },
      });
    }

    const remainingLegs = await this.prisma.callLeg.count({
      where: {
        callId,
        tenantId: this.tenantId,
        endedAt: null,
      },
    });

    if (remainingLegs <= 0) {
      const session = await this.prisma.callSession.update({
        where: {
          tenantId_linkedid: {
            tenantId: this.tenantId,
            linkedid,
          },
        },
        data: {
          sessionStatus: SessionStatus.ENDED,
          endedAt: new Date(),
        },
      });

      if (session.primaryAgentId) {
        await this.agentStateService.setStatus({
          tenantId: this.tenantId,
          agentId: session.primaryAgentId,
          statusCode: AgentStatusCode.AFTER_CALL_WORK,
          sourceType: AgentStateSourceType.system,
        });
      }

      await this.originateService.transitionByLinkedid(linkedid, OriginateRequestStatus.completed);

      this.realtimeGateway.broadcast('call.ended', {
        callId: session.callId,
        linkedid,
        endedAt: session.endedAt,
      });
    }
  }

  private async handleTransferRelated(callId: string, linkedid: string, event: AmiEventMap): Promise<void> {
    const eventName = event.Event ?? '';
    const fromExt = event.TransfererChannel?.split('/')[1]?.split('-')[0] ?? null;
    const toExt = event.TargetChannel?.split('/')[1]?.split('-')[0] ?? null;

    const fromAgent = fromExt
      ? await this.prisma.agent.findFirst({
          where: { tenantId: this.tenantId, extension: fromExt },
        })
      : null;

    const toAgent = toExt
      ? await this.prisma.agent.findFirst({
          where: { tenantId: this.tenantId, extension: toExt },
        })
      : null;

    if (eventName === 'AttendedTransfer') {
      await this.transferResolver.markTransferStarted({
        tenantId: this.tenantId,
        callId,
        linkedid,
        fromAgentId: fromAgent?.agentId ?? null,
        toAgentId: toAgent?.agentId ?? null,
        fromExtension: fromExt,
        toExtension: toExt,
        originalChannel: event.TransfererChannel ?? null,
        consultChannel: event.TargetChannel ?? null,
        originalUniqueid: event.TransfererUniqueid ?? null,
        consultUniqueid: event.TargetUniqueid ?? null,
        bridgeIdBefore: event.BridgeUniqueid ?? null,
      });
      return;
    }

    await this.prisma.callTransfer.create({
      data: {
        callId,
        tenantId: this.tenantId,
        linkedid,
        transferType: 'blind',
        fromAgentId: fromAgent?.agentId ?? null,
        toAgentId: toAgent?.agentId ?? null,
        fromExtension: fromExt,
        toExtension: toExt,
        transferResult: 'completed',
        requestedAt: new Date(),
        completedAt: new Date(),
      },
    });

    await this.prisma.callSession.update({
      where: {
        tenantId_linkedid: {
          tenantId: this.tenantId,
          linkedid,
        },
      },
      data: {
        transferFlag: true,
        primaryAgentId: toAgent?.agentId ?? undefined,
      },
    });
  }

  private async handleOriginateResponse(callId: string, linkedid: string, event: AmiEventMap): Promise<void> {
    const response = event.Response ?? '';
    if (response.toLowerCase() === 'failure') {
      await this.originateService.transitionByLinkedid(linkedid, OriginateRequestStatus.failed);
      return;
    }
    await this.originateService.transitionByLinkedid(linkedid, OriginateRequestStatus.sent);
  }
}
```

```ts
import { Body, Controller, Get, Param, Post } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiOperation, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { PrismaService } from '../../prisma/prisma.service';
import { OriginateCallDto } from '../dto/originate-call.dto';
import { TransferCallDto } from '../dto/transfer-call.dto';
import { CallCommandService } from '../services/call-command.service';
import { OriginateService } from '../services/originate.service';

@ApiTags('calls')
@Controller('api/calls')
export class CallsController {
  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly originateService: OriginateService,
    private readonly callCommandService: CallCommandService,
  ) {}

  @Get('active')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: '현재 활성 콜 목록' })
```

# 1. 운영 목표 재정의

단일 서버에서 “동작하는 시스템”과  
운영 환경에서 “버티는 시스템”은 다릅니다.

운영 수준에서는 다음 4가지를 만족해야 합니다.

1. **어떤 노드가 죽어도 통화 상태 정합성이 크게 무너지지 않을 것**
2. **AMI 이벤트가 중복 수신·역순 도착·일시 유실되어도 세션이 복원될 것**
3. **웹소켓 서버가 여러 대여도 상담원 화면이 동일 상태를 보게 할 것**
4. **Asterisk/앱/DB/Redis 중 일부 장애 시에도 복구 절차가 명확할 것**

기존 문서에서 제시된 `raw_ami_events`, `call_sessions`, `call_legs`, `queue_events` 분리 전략은 이 운영 목표의 기반이 됩니다. 운영판에서는 여기에 **이벤트 처리 계층을 더 세분화**해야 합니다. fileciteturn0file2

# 3. 멀티노드 전략

운영 레벨에서 가장 중요한 질문은 이겁니다.

## “AMI는 모든 앱 노드가 동시에 붙어도 되나?”

정답은 **붙을 수는 있지만, 처리 책임은 분리해야 한다**입니다.

### 권장안
- 모든 CTI App 노드가 모든 Asterisk 노드에 AMI 연결을 맺을 수 있음
- 하지만 **특정 Asterisk 노드의 raw event ingest 책임은 한 리더만 수행**
- 나머지 앱 노드는 standby 또는 command/API/WS 전용 역할 수행

즉,

- `asterisk-a` → `cti-leader-for-asterisk-a`
- `asterisk-b` → `cti-leader-for-asterisk-b`

형태로 **Asterisk별 리더 선출**을 합니다.

---

## 3.1 리더 선출 방식

Redis 분산 락 사용:

```text
lock key: leader:ami:asterisk-a
value: node-2
ttl: 15s
renew every: 5s
```

리더만 하는 일:
- 해당 PBX 노드 AMI raw event 수신
- `raw_ami_events` 저장
- Redis Pub/Sub 또는 Stream으로 표준 이벤트 발행
- 주기적 상태 스냅샷 동기화 실행

standby 노드는:
- 리더 락 감시
- 락 만료 시 takeover
- takeover 시 즉시 AMI reconnect + snapshot sync

---

## 3.2 왜 이 구조가 중요한가

모든 앱 노드가 같은 이벤트를 DB에 바로 반영하면:
- duplicate insert
- out-of-order overwrite
- queue summary double count
- websocket duplicate push

가 생깁니다.

따라서 운영판은 반드시 다음 두 단계를 나눠야 합니다.

### 단계 A. Raw ingest
- 한 리더만 raw 이벤트를 ingest

### 단계 B. Normalization / fan-out
- 정규화는 단일 consumer group 또는 strict idempotent consumer로 처리

---

# 4. 이벤트 처리 파이프라인 운영판

기존 MVP 수준은 보통 이렇습니다.

```text
AMI -> SessionEngine -> DB -> WS
```

운영판은 이렇게 바꿔야 합니다.

```text
AMI
 -> Raw Event Ingest
 -> Durable Event Bus
 -> Normalizer / Session Engine
 -> DB Transaction
 -> Outbox
 -> Redis PubSub
 -> WebSocket Gateway
```

---

## 4.1 단계별 책임

### 1) Raw Event Ingest
- 원본 수신 즉시 저장
- payload 원문 보존
- event fingerprint 생성
- replay 가능 상태 확보

### 2) Durable Event Bus
권장 순서:
- 1순위: PostgreSQL + outbox/inbox
- 2순위: Redis Streams
- 3순위: Redis Pub/Sub only 는 보조용

**Pub/Sub만으로는 복구성과 재처리가 약합니다.**

### 3) Normalizer
- 이벤트 순서 보정
- linkedid 기반 세션 병합
- uniqueid leg 보강
- Queue/Bridge/Hangup/Transfer 상호 참조

### 4) DB Transaction
- raw 저장과 normalized 반영을 분리
- session/leg/queue_fact/agent_state upsert
- 정확히 한 번은 어렵더라도 **실질적 once-effect** 보장

### 5) Outbox
- `call.updated`, `agent.status.changed`, `queue.summary.updated`
- commit 이후에만 외부 발행

### 6) WebSocket fan-out
- 모든 노드에 동일 이벤트 전파
- 특정 상담원/tenant/channel room으로 브로드캐스트

---

# 5. 이벤트 정합성 보강 핵심

기존 설계서가 말한 것처럼 운영 핵심은 **이벤트 정합성**입니다. fileciteturn0file1

운영판에서는 아래 8가지를 반드시 넣어야 합니다.

---

## 5.1 이벤트 fingerprint + dedupe

AMI 이벤트는 재접속 시 중복 수신될 수 있고,  
Asterisk 구성에 따라 유사 이벤트가 중첩될 수 있습니다.

예시 fingerprint:

```ts
fingerprint = sha1(
  [
    asteriskNodeId,
    event.Event,
    event.Linkedid || '',
    event.Uniqueid || '',
    event.DestUniqueid || '',
    event.BridgeUniqueid || '',
    event.Channel || '',
    event.DestChannel || '',
    event.Timestamp || '',
  ].join('|'),
);
```

Redis dedupe 키:

```text
dedupe:ami:{fingerprint} = 1 (TTL 6h)
```

DB 측 추가 방어:
```sql
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_raw_ami_event_fingerprint
ON raw_ami_events (tenant_id, event_fingerprint);
```

즉,
- Redis는 빠른 중복 차단
- DB unique index는 최종 방어선

---

## 5.2 linkedid 중심, uniqueid 보조

기존 문서 원칙 그대로, 운영판도 **linkedid를 세션 헤더의 유일 기준**으로 삼아야 합니다. fileciteturn0file2

- `call_sessions` = linkedid 중심
- `call_legs` = uniqueid 중심
- attended transfer 시 leg는 늘어나도 세션은 보통 linkedid 기준으로 유지
- blind transfer도 linkedid continuity를 우선 확인
- Queue 재시도/다중 agent ringing도 linkedid 세션 하위의 leg/event로 처리

---

## 5.3 이벤트 순서 역전 보정

AMI 이벤트는 실제로 다음 상황이 가능합니다.

- `Hangup` 이 `BridgeLeave` 보다 먼저 들어옴
- `AgentComplete` 가 `Hangup` 뒤에 늦게 들어옴
- `QueueCallerLeave` 없이 `Abandon` 성격 종료가 생김
- `BridgeEnter` 두 번, `BridgeLeave` 한 번처럼 짝이 어긋남

해결법은 “이벤트 하나마다 즉시 최종 상태 확정”이 아니라  
**세션 상태 전이 규칙 + 타임윈도우 보정**입니다.

예:

```ts
const SESSION_PRECEDENCE = {
  NEW: 1,
  IVR: 2,
  QUEUED: 3,
  RINGING_AGENT: 4,
  TALKING: 5,
  HOLD: 6,
  TRANSFERRING: 7,
  AFTER_CALL_WORK: 8,
  ENDED: 9,
};
```

하지만 단순 precedence만 쓰면 안 됩니다.  
`ENDED`는 강하지만, 이후 `AgentComplete`가 오면 세션을 죽은 채로 두고 **ACW만 보강**해야 합니다.

즉,
- 세션 상태
- 타임스탬프
- leg 종료 여부
- queue 완료 이벤트 존재 여부
를 함께 봐야 합니다.

---

## 5.4 soft close / hard close

운영판은 `ENDED`를 두 단계로 가져가는 것이 좋습니다.

### soft close
- 주요 leg hangup 확인
- UI에는 종료로 표시
- 하지만 10~30초 동안 후행 이벤트 허용

### hard close
- close grace window 경과
- queue complete / transfer finalize / recording finalize 처리 완료
- 통계 확정

예:

```text
session_status = ENDED
finalization_status = SOFT_CLOSED | FINALIZED
```

이 구조가 있어야
- 늦게 도착한 `AgentComplete`
- 녹취 파일 size 확정
- transfer completion
을 안전하게 반영할 수 있습니다.

---

## 5.5 periodic reconciliation

운영판에서 가장 중요한 안정장치 중 하나입니다.

주기적으로:
- `core show channels concise`
- `queue show`
- `pjsip show endpoints`
- 필요 시 AMI action 결과

를 기준으로 현재 상태를 재동기화합니다.

목적:
- 유령 TALKING 세션 정리
- 이미 종료된 leg 종료 처리
- queue waiting count correction
- agent 상태 stale 정리

즉, 이벤트 기반만 믿지 말고 **스냅샷 보정 루프**를 추가해야 합니다.

기존 설계서의 “AMI 재접속 후 주기적 상태 재동기화” 원칙을 운영 수준으로 구체화한 것입니다. fileciteturn0file1

---

## 5.6 orphan session sweeper

예:
- `RINGING_AGENT` 120초 유지
- `TALKING`인데 bridge 없음
- `QUEUED`인데 queue에 없음
- `AFTER_CALL_WORK` 2시간 유지

이런 세션을 정리해야 합니다.

예시 기준:
- `NEW` 30초 초과 → stale 검사
- `RINGING_AGENT` 90초 초과 → timeout 종료 후보
- `TALKING`인데 active leg 모두 종료 → soft close
- `AFTER_CALL_WORK` 10분 초과 → 강제 종료 + 자동 result code

---

## 5.7 raw replay 가능 구조

운영에서 꼭 필요합니다.

장애 사례:
- Session Engine bug
- 새 attended transfer 매핑 로직 배포
- 특정 기간 queue summary 재계산 필요

이때 `raw_ami_events`를 기준으로 재처리 가능해야 합니다.

재처리 원칙:
- 특정 linkedid 범위 replay
- 특정 기간 replay
- 특정 tenant replay
- dry-run compare 모드 지원

즉, raw event는 단순 감사 로그가 아니라 **복구와 재산출의 근거 데이터**입니다. 이는 업로드 문서의 raw 저장 전략과 직접 맞닿아 있습니다. fileciteturn0file2

---

## 5.8 outbox / inbox 패턴

멀티노드에서 이벤트 중복 발행 방지를 위해 필요합니다.

### outbox_events
DB commit 후 외부 발행할 이벤트

### inbox_events
이미 처리한 외부/내부 이벤트 기록

예시:

```sql
CREATE TABLE outbox_events (
  outbox_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  aggregate_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  aggregate_id UUID NOT NULL,
  event_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  payload JSONB NOT NULL,
  published_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE inbox_events (
  inbox_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  source_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  source_event_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  processed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE (source_name, source_event_id)
);
```

# 6. Redis 활용 설계

Redis는 캐시만이 아니라 **멀티노드 조정 계층**으로 씁니다.

---

## 6.1 Redis 사용 목적

### 필수
- 리더 락
- websocket backplane
- dedupe key
- agent presence cache
- queue summary cache

### 권장
- transient call state cache
- replay cursor
- rate limit
- node heartbeat

### 선택
- Redis Streams 기반 durable handoff

---

## 6.2 Redis 키 설계 예시

```text
leader:ami:asterisk-a -> node-1
leader:ami:asterisk-b -> node-2

dedupe:ami:{fingerprint} -> 1
ttl: 21600

presence:agent:{tenantId}:{agentId} -> JSON
ttl: 120

call:live:{tenantId}:{linkedid} -> JSON
ttl: 3600

queue:summary:{tenantId}:{queueName} -> JSON
ttl: 10

ws:session:{tenantId}:{userId}:{socketId} -> node-3
ttl: 90

node:heartbeat:{nodeId} -> alive
ttl: 15
```

---

## 6.3 WebSocket backplane

모든 노드가 다음 채널을 구독합니다.

```text

tenant:{tenantId}:calls
tenant:{tenantId}:agents
tenant:{tenantId}:queues
user:{userId}:screenpop
```

Node 1에서 처리된 `call.updated`가 Redis Pub/Sub로 나가면  
Node 2, Node 3에 붙은 소켓 사용자도 동일 이벤트를 받습니다.
